xsd.validator: xmllint (libxml2) vs x3d-4.0.xsd from x3d_mcp + XSD patched: pickTarget added to the containerField values

scope: compared with X_ITE 16.6.0 in scene mode: sensors in a Transform with a Shape sibling (X_ITE 16.6.0 does not traverse a group that holds only a pick sensor, so the fixtures add a 0.02 unit Box beside each sensor); pickable, objectType (ALL, NONE, one type), MATCH_ANY, MATCH_EVERY and MATCH_ONLY_ONE with one matching type, visible false
a sensor of objectType ALL sees through any group; a group of type ALL is seen by every sensor (as X_ITE 16.6.0)

MATCH_EVERY and MATCH_ONLY_ONE with two matching types follow 19775-1 (every type of the sensor must be in the group, exactly one must be); X_ITE 16.6.0 counts at most one match, so those two steps run in ours only
